Central Meadows has no official City boundary; the closest official planning name is the Official Community Plan (OCP) Municipal Town Centre.

The Town Centre covers the Harris Road corridor and the North Lougheed Area and the Civic Centre, with Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) at the north edge and the Canadian Pacific Kansas City (CPKC) rail line along Hammond Road.
Harris Road is the main street, and City Hall at 12007 Harris Road sits in the civic core beside the recreation centre and library.
Mid Meadows lies southeast, West Meadows west, North Meadows across Lougheed Highway, and Maple Ridge east.
The stock is an established Town Centre mix: detached houses on the interior streets, with multifamily buildings concentrated on Harris Road.
The OCP designates the Town Centre for high and medium density multifamily and mixed-use commercial and residential development, so the Harris Road frontage differs from the interior streets.
2505, 2011, with subdivision minimums from 1,215 square metres in R-3, R-4 and R-6 to 0.2 hectares in RS.

blocks.text: Central Meadows: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Central Meadows drains through urban drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) of the Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District, serviced by ditches, culverts and storm sewers discharging to the Alouette, Pitt and Fraser Rivers.

The civic core is walkable in one block: sxwhekwnes (Spirit Square) at 11985 Harris Road, Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre at 12027 Harris Road and Pitt Meadows Public Library at 200-12099 Harris Road.
Harris Road holds registered heritage buildings, including the Pitt Meadows General Store and Post Office at 12294 Harris Road, now the Pitt Meadows Museum.

Meadowtown Shopping Centre at 19800 Lougheed Highway, at the area's northeast edge, holds the Real Canadian Superstore grocery store named in the City's commercial lands analysis, while Meadowvale Shopping Centre on Harris Road North holds Save-On-Foods.
Pitt Meadows Regional Airport (YPK) is west of the area, and the City maintains a page for airport safety and noise concerns.
The nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital at 11666 Laity Street in Maple Ridge, a Fraser Health community hospital with 24/7 emergency care.
Pitt Meadows' 2026 general municipal residential rate is $2.8438 per $1,000 of taxable value, plus the $0.1082 drainage rate, under Bylaw No. 3047, 2026, adopted May 5, 2026.
Pitt Meadows Station on Harris Road is the transit anchor: West Coast Express trains run to Waterfront Station, Vancouver, Monday to Friday in peak periods.
The City states the West Coast Express trip from Pitt Meadows to downtown Vancouver is about 45 minutes.

Bus connections at the station include route 701 to Coquitlam Central Station and Haney Place via Harris Road and Hammond Road, route 791 to Braid Station and Haney Place, the 719/722 Meadowtown–Fraser Way circular service, and the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stop at Harris Road.
Golden Ears Way and the Golden Ears Bridge, east of the area, are the driving route toward Langley and Surrey.

blocks.text: Central Meadows: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start on the City's Dikes page: the city is almost entirely protected by 60 kilometres of dikes, and the Diking District is defined by the Fraser, Pitt and Alouette River dikes.

Check the lot against the Floodplain Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008: its Designated Flood Level is 1.85 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum for the Schedule A Rural Floodplain and 5.15 metres for the Schedule B Urban Floodplain.
Note the superseded figure: an older City document stated about 86 percent of the city in the floodplain; the City's 2020 Business Plan figure of over 95 percent is the current one and governs.
Check Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status per address: the City states 78 percent of its land base is in the ALR.
The dike pages do not tell a buyer an individual home's flood construction level or insurance position; that comes from the property's own permit history.
